notes.title: Super RPS is now available to play for free!
notes.content:
Super RPS is now live! It's been an insane journey getting to this point, but I've thoroughly enjoyed the process of making this game and I hope you guys can enjoy playing it! If you have any issues or suggestions while playing the game, we have forums under the Steam page for Super RPS to report them, or you can join the Discord linked below and post there. Again, since this game is Free To Play, I won't be making any money from it, but if you guys would like to support future creative endeavors, please join the Discord and check out my YouTube channel! Thank you guys again! 

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/pshZtWJxVV
YT: https://www.youtube.com/@BlueExabyte
